name: PCB BAKING OVEN
desc: Industrial PCB Baking and Curing Oven designed for precise thermal curing and moisture removal from printed circuit boards. Innolab Instruments supplies these heavy-duty 220-liter ovens with uniform heat distribution and PID closed-loop control to ensure flawless soldering and processing.
features: PID closed-loop control paired with high-efficiency SSR drive
Fast heating up time tracking under 30 minutes
High-capacity processing accommodating up to 70 PCBs
